turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: Invisalign™ Aligner Cleaning Foam: 1. Dispense 1 full pump of foam inside each aligner and spread it evenly. 2. Place the aligners back in your mouth and spit out any excess foam. 3. No rinsing is required. 4. Use it up to 4 times daily. For at-home cleaning, place the aligners in an Invisalign™ Aligner Case, cover them with foam, and let them sit for up to 5 minutes. Rinse and brush them before reinserting if desired. The foam is compatible with Invisalign® clear aligners and Vivera® retainers.
